findings.title: Static Numerical Epoch Offset Ineffective Against High-Epoch Split Brain
findings.remediation: Introduced ClusterIncarnationId and cryptographic ClusterAuthorityRecord. Storage nodes bind to monotonic incarnation sequence and reject older incarnations regardless of epoch counter value.

findings.title: Unverified Old-Quorum Coexistence Allowed Concurrent Split-Brain Mutations
findings.remediation: Storage nodes verify operational isolation and old quorum fencing assertions upon authority adoption; unverified coexistence triggers fail-closed mutation freeze.

findings.title: Offline Quorum Checkpoints Falsely Claimed Global Latest Freshness
findings.remediation: Counterexample demonstrated: majority checkpoint at term T does not preclude term T+1 commits. Reclassified offline checkpoints as AuthenticatedCommittedCheckpoint; AuthenticGlobalLatest strictly reserved for live cluster sync proof.

findings.title: TOCTOU Race Condition Between GC Deletion Eligibility Check and Active Repair
findings.remediation: Implemented multi-stage deletion lifecycle (Candidate -> EligibilityChecked -> DeletionReserved -> Tombstoned -> Quarantined -> PhysicallyDeleted) with pre-deletion active repair and active generation revalidation.

findings.title: String Regex Secret Scanner Permitted Raw Binary Key Inclusions
findings.remediation: Implemented StrictMetadataAllowlist type-level isolation enforcing valid 32-byte Ed25519 public keys only, eliminating private key leakage by construction.
